photographs.note: Official-source reuse follows the existing owner-approved moderate-risk policy. Attribution is not permission and independent reuse clearance is not claimed. All images inspected, identified and credited with direct source links. Low-resolution promotional banners, unrelated Manze shops, Almoina cathedral images and beginner-inappropriate workshop outcomes rejected.

rejectedOrDeferred.reason: Current municipal listing states temporary closure for waterproofing and improvement works. Older open-hours listings are insufficient.

rejectedOrDeferred.candidate: Jacobo and María Ángeles short painting workshop
rejectedOrDeferred.reason: The old visitor page is unavailable. Current site establishes guided visits and longer teaching but not the proposed short painting format. Replaced with a documented two-hour Ravenna course.
Visitor access, recruitment sessions and rehearsal schedules could not be reconciled sufficiently for an ordinary public visit without further contact.
Conflicting current operator information and misleading unofficial ticket sites left the access route insufficiently clear in this pass.

rejectedOrDeferred.candidate: Florence Il Papiro, Hong Kong Star Ferry and Wellington Cable Car
rejectedOrDeferred.reason: Already represented in the catalogue. Not counted as new experiences.

evidenceCorrections: The café homepage links the October 2026 menu, not the now-404 March menu. Page 10 checked visually and in text for almond granita, separate tasting servings and table-service surcharge.
Garfield entry is ticketed. Resident eligibility is not a universal free-entry offer, and the Fern Room is not wheelchair accessible.
HWIHO one-day decoration is distinct from regular traditional lacquer training. A bilingual website does not guarantee English teaching.
La Llotja is distinct from the existing Silk Museum guide. Tower booking is separate and the conflicting schedules are not promised.
National Noh subtitle support is programme-specific. Shunkoin and the Noh guide have shorter dated review windows.
Daily discovery remains at 128 existing entries rather than scheduling new material beyond its evidence-review window.
